## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the final change and why it is needed. Link the owning Issue.

## Compliance and scope

Cite the relevant CHALLENGE.md requirement; distinguish required behavior from a permitted choice. Record blocked contradictions and the compatible alternative. Identify affected workflows and material limits.

## Validation

List actual checks, candidate revision and useful CI/report links. Distinguish historical evidence from the current change. Explain remaining acceptance before merge.
